note: Touhou character battle themes (owner, 21 Oct 2026): a Touhou Pokemon in battle plays its character's theme, like a legendary's. Rendered from the MIDI transcriptions in git.psf.lt/80486DX2-66/touhou-midi-collection by tools/music/touhou.py (gm.dls, mono 64 kbps, -14 LUFS) into client/audio/touhou/<file>.mp3. folder/match = where the theme is in the collection; midi = the transcription used (the best-looping, fullest one); loop = [start ms, end ms] for the client, measured from the score (method); species = who it plays for (a forme shares its base's); source = which theme and why. A character with no theme of her own plays her stage's theme.
